'''Darth Andru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He lived on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] long before the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] returned to the known galaxy.

==Biography==
Andru, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], eventually attaining the title [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Andru. A practitioner of the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|technique]], Andru wielded two purple-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat. During his life on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Andru sought after ancient writings describing a powerful dark side ritual which would give the user mastery over the [[Force walk|Force-walking skill]].<ref name="TORE" /> His two children eventually conspired against him, poisoning and killing him.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Sith Hierarchy|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

Long after his death, Darth Andru's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] was locked within [[Darth Andru's tomb|his tomb]] where it seethed with an undying hatred. During the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Andru's wraith was confronted and subjugated by the [[Sith Inquisitor]] known as [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] who was able to master the [[Force walk|Force-walking]] technique and consume Andru's spirit. Absorbing Andru's energy and adding that to [[Ergast]]'s, Kallig confronted [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Thanaton]] and was soundly defeated, even with the added strength. However, the bond with the two ghosts kept Kallig from dying. The Sith Lord then decided to find more ghosts and use their power to defeat Thanaton. After adding [[Kalatosh Zavros]] and [[Horak-mul]] to the collection, Kallig returned to Dromund Kaas to face Thanaton. However, upon drawing on the power of all four ghosts, it became too much for Kallig to handle, causing the power to eat away Kallig's body while the ghosts threatened to drive them insane.<ref name="TORE" />

Kallig managed to overcome this and forcefully rebound the ghosts before defeating Thanaton and ascending to the Dark Council.
